d: CM Samrat Choudhary Vs Tejashwi Yadav:mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ki prastavit rajyavyapi samiksha yatra ko lekar siyasat tej ho gaee hai...26 navanbar se pashchim chanparan ke betiya se mukhyamantri apni yatra ki shuruaat karenge... lekin yatra shuru hone se pahle hi vipaksh ne sarkar ko gherna shuru kar diya hai... neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne saval uthaya hai ki aakhir ek sal men sarkar ne aisa kaun-sa kam kiya hai, jiski samiksha ki jaegi? tejasvi ne yatra ko transphar-posting aur vasuli se jorkar ganbhir aarop lagae hain...vahin bijepi aur jediyu ne bhi palatvar karte hue tejasvi…
